entries.text: You see Smitty.
entries.source_text: You see Smitty.

entries.text: You see a large, muscular man.
entries.source_text: You see a large, muscular man.

entries.text: Good day. What can I do for you?
entries.source_text: Good day. What can I do for you?

entries.text: What do you want?
entries.source_text: What do you want?

entries.text: May I ask your name?
entries.source_text: May I ask your name?

entries.text: I need you to fix these parts for me, so that I can fix your hydroponic farms.
entries.source_text: I need you to fix these parts for me, so that I can fix your hydroponic farms.

entries.text: I'd like to buy something.
entries.source_text: I'd like to buy something.

entries.text: Can I ask you a few questions?
entries.source_text: Can I ask you a few questions?

entries.text: Nothing, thanks. See you around.
entries.source_text: Nothing, thanks. See you around.

entries.text: Uhhh . . .
entries.source_text: Uhhh . . .

entries.text: I'd recommend that you check out Tine's store, just to one side of the gates. Idon't actually sell anything here; I trade it to Tine or the Hub merchants for goods.
entries.source_text:
I'd recommend that you check out Tine's store, just to one side of the gates. I
don't actually sell anything here; I trade it to Tine or the Hub merchants for goods.

entries.text: Why, everyone just calls me 'Smitty'. Probably because I'm the local blacksmith.
entries.source_text:
Why, everyone just calls me 'Smitty'.
 Probably because I'm the local blacksmith.

entries.text: Ask away.
entries.source_text: Ask away.

entries.text: Where did you get all of your shop equipment?
entries.source_text: Where did you get all of your shop equipment?

entries.text: What all do you make here?
entries.source_text: What all do you make here?

entries.text: Can you make guns and bullets?
entries.source_text: Can you make guns and bullets?

entries.text: Nothing else, thanks.
entries.source_text: Nothing else, thanks.

entries.text: I'm sorry, I don't think I can help you. Try Zimmerman.
entries.source_text: I'm sorry, I don't think I can help you. Try Zimmerman.

entries.text: Sure.
entries.source_text: Sure.

entries.text: Why, any competent blacksmith can make his own anvil! 'course, I really just sort of learned the craft by practice, but I made most of my own tools.
entries.source_text:
Why, any competent blacksmith can make his own anvil!
 'course, I really just sort of learned the craft by practice,
 but I made most of my own tools.

entries.text: Mostly I make and repair tools and implements here. I also fix things for the Hub merchants. With the help of Miles, the chemist, I reload bullets from time to time.
entries.source_text:
Mostly I make and repair tools and implements here.
 I also fix things for the Hub merchants. With the help of Miles,
 the chemist, I reload bullets from time to time.

entries.text: Well, building guns and making shells takes machining, and I just don't have the tools for that. But with the help of Miles, the chemist, I can reload old brass, since I can cast bullets.
entries.source_text:
Well, building guns and making shells takes machining, and I just don't have
 the tools for that. But with the help of Miles, the chemist, I can reload old brass,
 since I can cast bullets.

entries.text: Yes, I can fix this. Give me some time.
entries.source_text: Yes, I can fix this. Give me some time.

entries.text: Here you are. [Smitty hands you the fixed parts.]
entries.source_text: Here you are. [Smitty hands you the fixed parts.]

entries.text: I already fixed the parts. You need to give them to Miles now.
entries.source_text: I already fixed the parts. You need to give them to Miles now.

entries.text: Thanks for fixin' the farms. If you ever find yourself a plasma rifle, bring it on back here. I know a few tricks that I can pull with the injectors.
entries.source_text:
Thanks for fixin' the farms. If you ever find yourself a plasma rifle, bring
 it on back here. I know a few tricks that I can pull with the injectors.

entries.text: Well, I have one right here.
entries.source_text: Well, I have one right here.

entries.text: So you found yourself a plasma rifle!
entries.source_text: So you found yourself a plasma rifle!

entries.text: Hand it over and I'll take a look at it. [Smitty takes a plasma rifle from you, pulls out his tools, and starts to tinker with it.]
entries.source_text:
Hand it over and I'll take a look at it. [Smitty takes a plasma rifle
 from you, pulls out his tools, and starts to tinker with it.]

entries.text: There, I think that does it. [Smitty hands you back your plasma rifle.] Try that out for size.
entries.source_text:
There, I think that does it. [Smitty hands you back your plasma rifle.]
 Try that out for size.

entries.text: Like I said before, if you get yourself a plasma rifle and bring it back here, I can tweak it some for you.
entries.source_text:
Like I said before, if you get yourself a plasma rifle
 and bring it back here, I can tweak it some for you.

entries.text: Good seein' you again. Hope you're doing all right.
entries.source_text: Good seein' you again. Hope you're doing all right.
